erratum.what: The previously recorded boundaries for Theragāthā (first_ord 1849) and Therīgāthā (first_ord 3140) were LATE by 1 and 4 paragraphs. They were called 'confirmed two independent ways', but both ways shared one dependency: the corpus `book` field.
erratum.why: On a new book's first page the running header prints 'Ekakanipāta', not the book title, so book_of()'s carry-forward kept those paragraphs in the previous book. The book-end colophon check confirmed only the PREVIOUS book's end page, not the new book's first ordinal.
erratum.effect_if_unfixed: Petavatthu rendered Theragāthā verse 1 ('Channā me kuṭikā'); Theragāthā rendered Therīgāthā verses 1-4; Therīgāthā LOST its own first four verses. Demonstrated by running _19bleed.js against nav.json.bak19: 3 of 4 books fail.

pdf_page_note: PDF pages 142 and 392 are BLANK separators which the corpus `pdf_page` anchor does not count, so the corpus page anchor runs 1 low after p142 and 2 low after p392 (ord1848 says 234, is 235; ord3136 says 391, is 393). The earlier pdf ranges in this file inherited that drift. Volume text = pdf 17-451; pages 452-547 are back matter (word/name/verse indices + Sodhanapattaṁ errata).
cover_note: The 79% 'cover' in docs/verify_report.md is NOT lost extraction: the PDF is 547 pages and the text ends at 451, so 435/547 = 79.5%. Coverage over the real text range 17-451 is complete.
